verdict.rationale: Docs confirm browser extension autofills passkeys during sign-in and stores/retrieves one-time passwords (TOTP), covering both parts of the story, with community corroboration of browser extension quality and iframe-aware autofill behavior. Missing for 10: explicit first-party statement or hands-on demo showing TOTP codes specifically autofilled (rather than just 'stored/accessed') and independent confirmation of passkey autofill working reliably across sites.
